howto.name: Upload 2+ videos
howto.text: MP4 / MOV / MKV / WebM / AVI, up to 20 clips; the whole upload has to fit within the 500 MB request limit.

howto.name: Reorder if needed
howto.text: Use the up and down arrows to set the order the clips play in. The first clip sets the frame size of the merged video.

howto.name: Download the merged video
howto.text: FFmpeg joins the clips in that order into one MP4. Clips recorded the same way (H.264 or HEVC video with AAC audio, and the same frame size, rotation and encoder settings, as one phone's clips usually are) are joined as they are, without re-encoding. Any other mix is re-encoded once, as H.264 video and AAC audio.

faq.q: Do the videos need the same resolution?
faq.a: No. The merged video takes the first clip's frame size as players show it, so a portrait phone clip first gives a portrait video. Every other clip is scaled to fit inside that frame without being stretched, and black bars fill any gap. Put the clip whose size you want first.
Silent audio is added (anullsrc) for missing tracks so concatenation succeeds.

faq.q: Can I add a transition between clips?
faq.a: No. Clips are joined directly, one after another; transitions such as crossfades are not supported.

faq.q: How long can the merged video be?
faq.a: Clips joined as they are take seconds at any length that fits in the 500 MB upload. A mix that has to be re-encoded gets 180 seconds of FFmpeg time, so what fits depends on the total length and frame size: on the PrivaTools server, about three minutes of 1080p video in all, or under a minute of 4K, and less while the server is busy. A longer merge stops with "The server took too long"; join fewer or shorter clips at a time, or make them smaller first with Video Resizer. The route takes 5 requests a minute per IP address.
